questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The Sports Minister ________ the Badminton Association officials that all help will be given to them to conduct the tournament.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'assured'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assured** means believing that you can do something or succeed at something; confident.

 ** • Example- **We assured him of our loyal support.

 
• So, it is clear that the word **'assured'** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

**​The complete sentence is**- *The Sports Minister assured__** the Badminton Association officials that all help will be given to them to conduct the tournament.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Committed** means prepared to give a lot of your time and attention to something because you believe it is right or important.
 
• **Ascertained** means to find out or learn with certainty.
 
• **Demonstrated** means to show and explain to somebody how to do something or how something works.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

If you are in trouble, Tommy is the friend who __stands by__ you.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'will stand by'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace **'stands by'** with **'will stand by' **to make the sentence correct.
 
• Will and shall are **modal verbs**.
 
• They are used with the base form of the main verb.
 
• **Rules :**

​ • If the **conditional clause** is in **'if + Present simple'**

 • Then we use the **modal verb** in the **main clause** with **future** meaning.

 
• Here, In the given sentence- **'If you are in trouble'** is a conditional clause,__ and **'Tommy is the friend who will stand by you.'** is the __main clause__.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 2.**

**The corrected sentence** is**:** *"If you are in trouble, Tommy is the friend who will stand by you."*
